name: Enterprise Collective, Team and Community
constraints: WM-ORG-003 owns collective identity, charter, lifecycle and team assignments.
WM-ORG-006 owns governed admission-based membership and standing.
Assignment and membership remain separate facts and lifecycles.
Neither assignment nor membership grants employment, funding, product access or authority.
Peer-sponsored collectives allow optional containment, multiple sponsors and managing organizations.
Exactly one record-authority organization is explicit for each collective record.
Participants are referenced and person data is not copied into the collective.
A community of practice has governed membership but no implied delivery mandate or capacity allocation.
Collective dissolution never ends employment, unrelated memberships or external grants.
Technical-domain classifiers own no people, memberships or charters.
